mysql_server.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address. Use 'localhost' for Unix socket or omit port when using socket.

mysql_port.description: Port number for MySQL server. Use 0 or omit if using Unix socket.

mysql_socket.description: Path to MySQL Unix socket (e.g., /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock). If provided, overrides server/port.

mysql_user.description: MySQL username with SELECT access to the FTP user table.

mysql_password.description: Password for the MySQL user. Keep this secure; never commit to source control.

mysql_database.description: Name of the database containing the FTP user table.

mysql_getpw.default: SELECT User FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1" AND Status="1"
mysql_getpw.description: SQL query to verify a user's existence and active status. \$1 is replaced with the username.

mysql_getuid.default: SELECT Uid FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getuid.description: SQL query to retrieve the numeric UID for the user.

mysql_getgid.default: SELECT Gid FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getgid.description: SQL query to retrieve the numeric GID for the user.

mysql_getdir.default: SELECT Dir FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getdir.description: SQL query to retrieve the user's home directory path.

mysql_crypt.description: Password hashing scheme used in the DB. 'none' means plain text; 'crypt' uses system crypt().

mysql_default_homedir.description: Fallback home directory for users who lack a Dir field in the database.

mysql_getqtasz.default: SELECT QuotaSize FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getqtasz.description: SQL query to retrieve per-user disk quota in MB (0 = unlimited).

mysql_getqtafs.default: SELECT QuotaFiles FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getqtafs.description: SQL query to retrieve per-user file count quota (0 = unlimited).

mysql_getbandwidthin.default: SELECT UploadBandwidth FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getbandwidthin.description: SQL query to retrieve per-user upload bandwidth limit in KB/s (0 = unlimited).

mysql_getbandwidthout.default: SELECT DownloadBandwidth FROM ftpd WHERE User="\$1"
mysql_getbandwidthout.description: SQL query to retrieve per-user download bandwidth limit in KB/s (0 = unlimited).
